sentences.en: The capital of the state is right on the equator.
sentences.zh: 这个州的首都是在赤道上。

sentences.en: Near the equator, the weather is hot and humid year-round.
sentences.zh: 靠近赤道的地方全年都炎热潮湿。

sentences.en: Quito, Ecuador, is a little south of the equator.
sentences.zh: 厄瓜多尔的基多位于赤道以南一点点。

senses.zh: 赤道,（平分球形物体的面的）圆,（任何）大圆
